astra-task-demos.label: Astra
astra-task-demos.note: Described by the top-level fields of this file (sourceCommit, scope, playback, presentation, notes).

task87-scripted-reference.label: Scripted reference controller
task87-scripted-reference.scope: The task's own recorded reference episodes, one per persona; not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate.
task87-scripted-reference.playback: Complete recorded episodes at simulation rate (12 s, 24 fps). MP4 files are copied byte for byte, without trimming or re-encoding.
task87-scripted-reference.presentation: Scripted reference policy with explicit persona and simulator state; fixed-base G1; no perception, locomotion, or learned policy claim.
task87-scripted-reference.evaluation: Each episode passes the native evaluator for its own persona and fails it when scored against the other persona (source report.json: evaluation and wrong_persona_evaluation).

task-records-17-19.label: Scripted reference controller
task-records-17-19.scope: The task's own recorded reference episodes (task records on benchmark main); not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate.
task-records-17-19.playback: Complete recorded episodes at simulation rate (10 fps, 960×720). MP4 files are copied byte for byte, without trimming or re-encoding.
task-records-17-19.presentation: Recorded in Isaac Sim 5.1 in the furnished room with fixed-base exact-state IK and native PhysX contacts. Contact records include self and environment contacts; collision-free motion is not certified.
task-records-17-19.evaluation: Each episode passes the task's measured full-trajectory scoring for its own persona (source report.json). The reports do not score the episode against the other persona.

prb-scripted-expert-physics.label: Scripted expert
prb-scripted-expert-physics.scope: Physics episodes of the benchmark's scripted expert, which reads privileged simulator state (object poses and the persona's goal). Not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate; one passing episode per persona was chosen for visual clarity.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.playback: Complete recorded episodes at 1× simulated time (every second recorded state, 15 fps). 1280×720 H.264: the room view with a robot head-camera inset.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.presentation: Simulated in Isaac Sim 6.0 with PhysX contacts, a kinematically commanded base (no balance controller) and assisted grasping (a hand closing within 3.5 cm of an object attaches it rigidly). The recorded scene states are re-rendered in the furnished room with persona_robot_bench/sim/render.py --gait; nothing is re-simulated. The base moves kinematically, so for display the legs are animated to step along its path (planned footsteps and G1 leg IK, sim/gait.py); recorded leg poses such as squats and leans are kept.
prb-scripted-expert-physics.evaluation: Each episode meets its own persona's goal with every object at rest and the physics checks passed (result.json outcome.personalized_success and execution.faithful), and does not meet the other persona's goal (outcome.wrong_persona_success is false).

prb-scripted-expert-kinematic.label: Scripted expert (kinematic)
prb-scripted-expert-kinematic.scope: Kinematic-backend episodes of the benchmark's scripted expert, which reads privileged simulator state (object poses and the persona's goal). Shown for tasks whose physics episodes do not yet pass for both personas. Not a model rollout and not a success-rate estimate; one passing episode per persona was chosen for visual clarity.
prb-scripted-expert-kinematic.playback: Complete recorded episodes at 1× simulated time (every second recorded state, 15 fps). 1280×720 H.264: the room view with a robot head-camera inset.
prb-scripted-expert-kinematic.presentation: Simulated on the benchmark's kinematic backend: no contact dynamics, a grasped object moves rigidly with the hand and a released object is placed at its released pose; furniture penetration is still checked. The recorded scene states are rendered in Isaac Sim 6.0 in the furnished room with persona_robot_bench/sim/render.py --gait; nothing is re-simulated. The base moves kinematically, so for display the legs are animated to step along its path (planned footsteps and G1 leg IK, sim/gait.py); recorded leg poses such as squats and leans are kept.
prb-scripted-expert-kinematic.evaluation: Each episode meets its own persona's goal and passes the kinematic execution checks (result.json outcome.personalized_success and execution.faithful), and does not meet the other persona's goal (outcome.wrong_persona_success is false).

astra-high-selected-180s.label: Astra high
astra-high-selected-180s.scope: Ten selected task demonstrations, one newly completed episode per persona. These 20 selected episodes are not a benchmark success-rate estimate and do not change the published leaderboard.
astra-high-selected-180s.inference: Fresh gpt-6-astra high-reasoning skill plans through the authenticated local Codex CLI. Complete structured simulator observations, privileged reference goals and native skill contracts are provided. Native IK/motion-planning controllers execute selected skills in PhysX, with assisted grasping and kinematic base control; no learned motor-action-head or unassisted balance claim.
astra-high-selected-180s.modelIdentity: Retained CLI commands select gpt-6-astra and high reasoning. Backend model identity is not independently provider-attested.
astra-high-selected-180s.timeAllowance: Only these demonstration task objects use a private 180-second allowance, including final settling. Other goal, process, dynamics and execution-fidelity criteria are unchanged.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Held object contacted furniture during transfer; final goal alone did not qualify this attempt.

astra-high-selected-180s.playback: Complete measured trajectories at 1× simulation time, omitting inference waits. Measured poses sampled at 15 Hz are held at 30 fps without interpolation or time compression; the final sample lasts one 30 Hz frame. Website MP4s and posters are copied byte for byte from verified exports.
astra-high-selected-180s.presentation: Offline OpenUSD Storm rendering of measured object/base poses and forward kinematics of all 43 recorded G1 joint angles, including recorded passive fixtures. Rendering makes zero physics steps and zero model calls. These are not policy camera observations; no additional leg animation is introduced.

rendering.backgrounds: Current furnished room scenes, including current task-specific context layers for Tasks 25 and 30. Tasks 85 and 86 retain their authored furnished construction/maintenance worksites.
rendering.camera: Authored overview transform/horizontal aperture, with vertical aperture matching 960 × 540 aspect.
rendering.lighting: Session-only scene light intensities scaled 0.001 for Storm; no extra camera headlight and no geometry or material replacement.

astra-high-selected-180s.evaluation: Each selected measured trajectory independently passes its native persona goal, process-validity and execution-fidelity checks with no timeout or controller error. Full native results are recomputed from original episodes, and every video is independently hashed and decoded.
astra-high-selected-180s.artifactAvailability: Original trajectories, CLI receipts, frozen source snapshot and independent audits are locally retained by the maintainers. Hashes identify those retained artifacts; the originals are not Git-tracked or downloadable from this website.
